# uiux

Review consistency with BFO Base, not personal aesthetics. Inspect trusted resources/spa/components
AppLayout, ListingTable, SlicePaginator, FilterPanel, existing forms/navigation and theme configuration;
compare candidate changes against equivalent existing screens. PrimeVue is the interactive base;
SPA supports Belarusian through resources/lang/by.json and i18n.ts. Check shared spacing, typography,
semantic actions, tables/filters/paginators, responsive overflow, keyboard/focus, labels, accessible
names, contrast tokens, day/night modes, loading/error/empty feedback and destructive-action clarity.
Report a specific inconsistency and cite the existing project pattern with user consequence.
Do not claim screenshots, pixel accuracy, actual contrast measurements or browser verification.
Always include limitation: UI/UX checked by source comparison, without browser visual validation.
